summary: Türkiye’s ecosystem pledges combine agriculture, conservation, restoration, and mixed water-management measures. In agriculture, 4.76 million hectares of land consolidation were completed by end-2020 (≈11% of current agricultural land cover), and 8.5 million hectares of inland consolidation are to be completed in 2023 (≈20%). Conservation commitments include river-basin management and water-allocation plans for 25 river basins, plus flood- and drought-forecasting and early-warning systems for 25 basins by 2030. Restoration focuses on increasing treated wastewater reuse in 35 wetlands that are or will dry out. Cross-cutting targets raise treated wastewater reuse to 15% by 2030 and complete flood- and drought-management plans for 25 river basins, with revisions every six years.

targets.metric: Wetlands targeted for treated wastewater reuse
